title: calamagrostis canescens f. geniculata
intro: Calamagrostis canescens f. geniculata, commonly known as bent or quaking grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and ease respiratory problems, making it a popular remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents present in Calamagrostis canescens f. geniculata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
